design_philosophy.description: Mostly crisp white with generous breathability, deep obsidian structure (#000000 / #0F172A), and glowing amber-to-rose-to-indigo gradient accents representing the signature Lumo app identity. High contrast, precise layout typography, interactive CSS phone mockups, and persona-driven conversion paths.
core_principles: Generous negative space with 2x-3x standard padding (py-24, gap-12)
Persona-first navigation & discovery (Customers, Workers, Sellers, Real Estate)
High-impact conversion focus: Download app badges, desktop QR floating drawer, and direct app store deep-linking
Tactile CSS Phone frames containing interactive state mockups instead of plain screenshots
Stark contrast with surgical use of color accents: Slate neutrals + Lumo signature gradient (#F59E0B → #EC4899 → #6366F1)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace top navigation links in NavBar.js with: Customers (/app/customers), Workers (/app/workers), Sellers (/app/sellers), Real Estate (/app/real-estate), How it works (/how-it-works), Blog (/blog), plus a Download CTA button.
2. Implement /app/customers, /app/workers, /app/sellers, and /app/real-estate category detail pages using the high-impact template defined above.
3. Build WebsiteHome.js around the primary goal: getting users to download the app with prominent App Store/Google Play badges, smart link modal, and QR code overlay.
4. Ensure every single interactive element has a clear data-testid attribute.
5. Style phone mockups using pure HTML/Tailwind CSS with live rendered app cards.
